import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1+n]
    itv = data[1+n]
    arr.sort()
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        bound = arr[i] + itv
        cnt = 0
        for j in range(i, n):
            if arr[j] <= bound:
                cnt += 1
        ans = max(ans, cnt)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
